hooks.name: Architecture Alignment Review
hooks.description: Reviews newly created source and infrastructure files against TaskFlow conventions.

action.prompt:
A new file was created under src/ or infra/. Review it against .kiro/steering/coding-standards.md and infra-guidelines.md:

1. Correct directory for its layer (api / domain / infrastructure)?
2. snake_case Python modules, kebab-case Terraform module directories?
3. Type hints on every function signature, no bare except?
4. Terraform: name_prefix used, required tags applied, variables typed and described, module has main.tf / variables.tf / outputs.tf / versions.tf?
5. Tenant-scoped data access goes through the tenant context dependency, never a raw unscoped query?

Report only violations, one line each. If aligned, say 'Aligned' and stop.
